run.name: Nabors Industries Ltd
run.title: CP-OS host session (NBR)
run.summary: Nabors has moderate leverage, no maturities before June 2029 and 825.1 US$m of liquidity, but earnings and receivables lean on Saudi Aramco and the SANAD venture. The credit view is balanced, with business risk the main weakness. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is NABORS INDUSTRIES LTD.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Face value 2,050.0 US$m at September 30, 2026 over LTM adjusted EBITDA 893.6 US$m (calculated); net of cash and short-term investments of 475.1 US$m, of which 180.6 US$m cash is held in SANAD; EBITDA includes 100% of SANAD

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Calculated: FY2025 adjusted EBITDA 912.7 US$m over cash paid for interest, net of capitalized interest, of 209.2 US$m (10-K page:121)

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and short-term investments at September 30, 2026, of which 180.6 is SANAD cash; no borrowings (10-Q Q3 page:16); the 68.2 of letters of credit under the credit agreement use the separate tranche; revolver term at the earliest June 2029

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Cash interest for 2026, the covenant EBITDA definition, SANAD earnings and backlog are not available, and the October rig-suspension news is a management statement.
CP-1 main limitation: Cash interest for 2026 is not reported in the quarterly filings, and covenant EBITDA is undefined in the pack, so coverage rests on interest expense and the reported ratio.
